description: Find restaurants that take orders through Toast near a point (latitude/longitude — this server has no geocoder, so convert an address or city first). Returns each restaurant's GUID (what toast_get_menu needs), shortUrl, ordering link, address and distance, nearest first. Toast's directory lists restaurants OPEN for the dining option at `when` (default now): an empty or short result late at night means closed, not absent — retry with a daytime `when`. Optional `name` filters the results. There is no paging: `total` is every match and `limit` (default 25, max 300) is how many come back.

dining_option.description: TAKE_OUT (default) or DELIVERY. DELIVERY lists only restaurants that deliver to the point.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search centre, decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search centre, decimal degrees.

name.description: Only restaurants whose name contains this (case/punctuation-insensitive).

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles (0.1–25, default 2). Toast caps one answer at 300 restaurants.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact (default) returns the shaped result; "full" returns the Toast gateway's raw `data` object untouched.

when.description: ISO-8601 date-time the order would be fulfilled at. Default: now.

name: toast_find_restaurants
